framings.label: Corporate governance and internal probe
framings.description: Coverage presents the story as a company matter: the board hiring a law firm or former prosecutor, the scope of the investigation, whether Huang is fired or reined in, and how he returns to the office.

framings.label: National security and espionage threat
framings.description: Posts frame the affair as a possible Chinese intelligence operation, citing government warnings, alleged ties enabling chip sales to China, and a suspected earlier shutdown of a smuggling probe.

framings.label: Political and congressional fallout
framings.description: Articles focus on lawmakers calling for federal probes, testimony or resignation, the bipartisan response, and disagreement over Trump's role and Nvidia's Washington standing.

framings.label: Market and industry risk
framings.description: Coverage treats the scandal as a financial and sector story, tracking share drops and rebounds, lost market value, customer and partner unease, and wider risk to the AI industry.

framings.label: Personal affair and human interest
framings.description: Pieces center on the personal side, including who Alice Huang is, his wife and family, his background story, and commentary on whether such behavior is commonplace or has an upside.
